days.title: Arrival in Edinburgh
days.desc: Welcome to the historic capital of Scotland, renowned for its rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant cultural scene. Begin your journey with a private transfer from Edinburgh airport to your hotel. Prepare to immerse yourself in the city's charm and heritage.
days.taste: A dram of single malt Scotch at a historic Royal Mile pub.

days.title: Edinburgh
days.desc: Enjoy a leisurely day in Edinburgh, exploring its historic sites, wandering along the Royal Mile, or visiting the majestic Edinburgh Castle. Delight in the city's cultural offerings at your own pace.
days.fallbackIncluded: Edinburgh 1 day hop on hop off | Loch Lomond, Stirling Castle, 10 hrs coach tour
days.experience: Climb Arthur’s Seat for a view over the whole city, or descend into the Real Mary King’s Close beneath the Royal Mile.

days.title: Edinburgh to Inverness
days.desc: Travel by train to Inverness, the gateway to the Scottish Highlands. Explore this charming city, nestled by the River Ness, known for its historic sites like Inverness Castle and the Caledonian Canal. Prepare for Highland adventures.
days.experience: The train skirts the Cairngorms and follows the shore of Loch Ness.

days.title: Inverness
days.desc: Embark on a full-day coach tour from Inverness, exploring the mesmerizing Isle of Skye and the iconic Eilean Donan Castle. Immerse yourself in Scotland's stunning landscapes and historic landmarks. Return for a tranquil evening in Inverness.

days.title: Inverness to Fort William
days.desc: Travel by bus to Fort William, a scenic town nestled at the foot of Ben Nevis, the UK's highest peak. Fort William is a gateway to outdoor adventures, offering stunning landscapes and access to hiking trails. Prepare for mountainous marvels.
days.experience: Ben Nevis, the UK’s highest peak, rises straight from Fort William’s edge.

days.title: Fort William to Glasgow
days.desc: Board the train to Glasgow, Scotland's largest city renowned for its vibrant arts scene, rich architectural heritage, and bustling city life. Embrace cultural diversity and explore the city's museums, galleries, and lively atmosphere.
days.taste: Fresh seafood or a hearty plate of stovies in one of Glasgow’s Merchant City restaurants.

days.title: Departure.
days.desc: Conclude your Scottish adventure with a private transfer from your Glasgow hotel to Glasgow airport. Depart with cherished memories of Scotland's captivating landscapes and vibrant cities.

about.title: Best season
about.body: May–September for long days; shoulder months quieter and better value

about.title: Weather
about.body: Mild and changeable. 12–20°C in summer. Pack a rain layer year-round

goodToKnow.title: Best season
goodToKnow.body: April–September for long days and best weather; shoulder months quieter and often better value.

goodToKnow.title: Currency & documents
goodToKnow.body: England/Scotland use £ GBP. Ireland uses € EUR. Both are Schengen-free — check your entry requirements.

goodToKnow.title: What to pack
goodToKnow.body: Layers and a waterproof in any month. Comfortable shoes for cobbles and coastal paths.

goodToKnow.title: Driving
goodToKnow.body: Drive on the left. Rural roads can be narrow — allow extra time. Petrol stations sparse in Highland areas.

goodToKnow.title: Rail travel
goodToKnow.body: Seat reservations are included on inter-city trains. Arrive 10 minutes before departure.

goodToKnow.title: Your vehicle
goodToKnow.body: Driver hours are limited to 10 hrs/day by law. Luggage space fits one large case per guest.

terms: All rates are net and per person for the package.

Child rates apply for children aged from 2 to 11 years old. 1 child sharing a room with 2 adults (depending on hotel policy). If the hotel doesn’t have availability for family rooms, adult rates will apply.
All rates are subject to availability at the time of booking. Europe Incoming will endeavour to match the rates quoted in the packages.
Rates quoted are not applicable during trade fair periods, major European Holidays and other major events.
City taxes are not included in the price.
If certain entrances are closed during certain periods, alternative entrances will be provided.
All bookings have to be confirmed at least 60 working days prior to arrival date by the Agent. Early bookings increase the chances of achieving the quoted package rate.
The prices we quote are indicative, but we always try to confirm the prices offered in this document.
We require 100% pre-payment either by bank transfer or by credit card (VISA or Mastercard). All charges for bank transfers need to be covered by the Agent.
Vouchers will be issued after receipt of the full payment in our bank account.
